title: Assessing greenspace and cardiovascular health through deep-learning analysis of street-view imagery in a cohort of US children.
summary: In Project Viva, deep-learning segmentation of street-view imagery produced ground-level greenspace measures linked to residential buffers and cardiovascular-health scores over childhood/adolescence. A 1-SD increase in street-view trees within 500 m was cross-sectionally associated with a 1.92-point higher late-adolescent score; longitudinal and cumulative exposure associations were not found. The observational result is limited and non-causal.
ai_technology: A deep-learning image-segmentation algorithm estimates street-view trees/grass/other greenspace; these learned exposure measures are the explanatory variables in the cohort analysis.
